name: dir-archiver
description: Bytefold-backed archive orchestration for directories/files across Node.js, Deno, and Bun.

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test test/api-snapshot.test.mjs test/operations.test.mjs test/cli.test.mjs test/matrix-node.test.mjs
scripts.check: node ./scripts/verify-runtime-versions.mjs && node ./scripts/workflow-policy-check.mjs && node ./scripts/esm-only-guard.mjs && node ./scripts/docs-policy-check.mjs && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run test:security && npm run test:runtimes
scripts.test:deno: npm run build && deno run --allow-read --allow-write --allow-env --allow-sys test/deno-smoke.mjs
scripts.test:runtimes: npm run test:deno && npm run test:bun && npm run test:runtimes:fingerprints
scripts.test:downstream:main: npm install --no-save github:Ismail-elkorchi/bytefold#main github:Ismail-elkorchi/argv-flags#main && npm run test
